title: Roadmap to the platinum — Vice Got a Price!
total_estimate_note: Estimate only: PowerPyx rates the set 4/10 and estimates ~200 hours to the platinum (story 60–80 h, 100% checklist ~100 h, Strangers & Freaks and cleanup ~10 h). Your time will vary.
warnings: THE ONE WARNING: in Chapter 1, the morning after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen, follow her to the balcony and accept her meditation (Positive Mental Attitude). It is gone after Chapter 1 and it is not yet confirmed whether the trophy needs it — PowerPyx's author did it and then earned the trophy. Do it.

There is no mission replay and no New Game+, but free-roam continues after the story and every trophy except possibly the Chapter 1 meditation stays earnable. Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter (15 manual slots; PowerPyx recommends 10 saves for chapter starts/ends) so a missed step never costs a full replay.
Cheats disable trophies and saving — keep them off for the whole run (PowerPyx, GTABase). Avoid the Irredeemable criminal profile: it is permanent and makes cops shoot on sight.
There are no difficulty settings, no mission gold medals and no online trophies. One playthrough is enough.

stages.title: Chapter 1 — learn Leonida, do the one thing you cannot redo
stages.hours_note: estimate; part of PowerPyx's 60–80 h story total
steps: Morning after Down to Earth: do Lucia's balcony meditation — the only possibly-missable step in the game (see Positive Mental Attitude).
After Feng Shui, follow Cal's fishing quests; meet Kenton and start his 7-shipwreck treasure line.
Scan every new vehicle with WAiNK and study animals with binoculars as you go — the counts carry into the 100% checklist.

stages.title: Chapters 2–3 — Vice City opens up; start the side lines
stages.hours_note: estimate; part of PowerPyx's 60–80 h story total
steps: Finish Chapters 2 and 3 (Breakfast Run, The Cartel Heist).
After Coffee Break (Ch. 2) you can switch characters and free-roam together — partner trophies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy) and duo training unlock from here.
Start Billy (Thrillbilly Mudclub), Randy (after Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS), Tyrone (after Here, Kitty Kitty), Andy (Lucia-only, Ch. 3) and Bret (Jason-only, after Coffee Break).
Unlock the Scooter Bros app (Moses, Ch. 2) and the Vice City Real Estate app (after Daily Driver) and start buying garages and registering vehicles.

stages.title: Chapters 4–5 — the finale; bank vaults open
stages.hours_note: estimate; part of PowerPyx's 60–80 h story total
steps: Finish Chapters 4 and 5 (Child's Play, Headliners, VCIA Takedown, Operation Savage Glory) and the final mission.

Do the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — it unlocks bank-vault robberies and counts as the armored-truck robbery; vaults pay up to $205,000 and feed the $250,000 laundering total.
Finish Credit Check (Ch. 3) for the Dye Pack Jammer so marked bills can be laundered at fences.

stages.title: 100% completion — the long grind (checklist appears after the story)
steps: Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work the list: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts — plus in full: all robberies, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations, all underwater discoveries, every shooting-range gold, all 42 drone races, all 15 Target Decks.

Grind order that saves time: stunts (under-bridge flights are fastest), WAiNK scans (100), drone races (finish all races at each of the 14 locations in one visit), shooting ranges (42 golds), then challenges (pick the easiest remaining).
Unfog the whole map by plane for The Goodtime State; it also reveals activities and collectibles.

stages.title: Strangers & Freaks and misc cleanup — the platinum
steps: Finish the 8 counting stranger strands (Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete confirmed) and the Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret finales.

Mop up the one-off feats: partner wanted-level escape, 3-shop robbery run, Combat Focus x5, the VCIA jet, the Rhino tank, the undetected jewelry robbery, Kingpin Bowling's 3 valuables, max Strength for both characters, 500 Criminal Profile actions.

Five trophies have no confirmed method in either cited guide yet (In The Beginning…, Capital Offense, Bad Luck, I Guess, The Truth Is Out There, Ten Pin) — check the guide notes in the tracker before chasing them; they may need a post-launch update.
Spend the $100,000 across shops, then Vice Got a Price! pops with the last trophy.
